title.narrative: Empowering Youth Community of Rubavu District in Integrated Peace Culture Education through Participation Approach in Rwanda

description.narrative:
Project’s main overall objective One to Two sentence (s) only To promote the Youth Community Awareness on Integrated Peace Culture Education through Interactive Training Sessions oriented to sustainable behavioural change for lasting peace in Rwanda and beyond.
Project’s specific objectives and planned activities to achieve expected results: A max. of 1000 words Firstly, the main objective of the current project aims at promoting the young people’s awareness living in Rubavu District of Rwanda in participating to effectively building sustainable peace education culture. Furthermore, for better implementing this initiative led to Youth Community Awareness on Participation to Peace Culture Education in Rwanda, researchers propose below a descriptive table no 1 showing relationships between the defined project’s specific objectives, indicated planned activities, and expected results. - To build capacity of targeted youth in Peace culture education - To organize interactive sessions based on educational case studies focused on Peace Culture through participation approach - To build youth critical thinking skills oriented to Peace Culture Education Awareness
